item.text: {"answer":"The four AI RMF Core functions are GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE.\n\nThe Generative AI Profile identifies twelve risks unique to or exacerbated by generative AI: (1) CBRN Information or Capabilities; (2) Confabulation; (3) Dangerous, Violent, or Hateful Content; (4) Data Privacy; (5) Environmental Impacts; (6) Harmful Bias and Homogenization; (7) Human-AI Configuration; (8) Information Integrity; (9) Information Security; (10) Intellectual Property; (11) Obscene, Degrading, and/or Abusive Content; (12) Value Chain and Component Integration.","citations":["anx://pdf-7576edb531d9848825814ee8/revisions/0/blocks/paragraph-095a6d48a28bb2c2","anx://pdf-6e73620ab6b64e90ef2c04bf/revisions/0/blocks/paragraph-28a18417e0a32017","anx://pdf-6e73620ab6b64e90ef2c04bf/revisions/0/blocks/heading-465dc9ea5b619dba","anx://pdf-6e73620ab6b64e90ef2c04bf/revisions/0/blocks/heading-0a6493c53bc64c89","anx://pdf-6e73620ab6b64e90ef2c04bf/revisions/0/blocks/heading-7c6eb191b6b353d2","anx://pdf-6e73620ab6b64e90ef2c04bf/revisions/0/blocks/heading-0b688da276ea710e","anx://pdf-6e73620ab6b64e90ef2c04bf/revisions/0/blocks/heading-ddf38880fe9e0e50","anx://pdf-6e73620ab6b64e90ef2c04bf/revisions/0/blocks/heading-76af01b649a27d67","anx://pdf-6e73620ab6b64e90ef2c04bf/revisions/0/blocks/heading-8bad8357d11ad863","anx://pdf-6e73620ab6b64e90ef2c04bf/revisions/0/blocks/heading-e27bb53257f5cc57","anx://pdf-6e73620ab6b64e90ef2c04bf/revisions/0/blocks/heading-5b5232fca9dc4e34","anx://pdf-6e73620ab6b64e90ef2c04bf/revisions/0/blocks/heading-9a7e689a6cdc3beb","anx://pdf-6e73620ab6b64e90ef2c04bf/revisions/0/blocks/heading-b8361830d590eb10","anx://pdf-6e73620ab6b64e90ef2c04bf/revisions/0/blocks/heading-39ab68c4ccea3ce0"],"confidence":1}
